content.comment_body: Hello again, I have configured [product_name] multi latest [version_no] following the instructions in the [document], but am unable to see changes in input and output status. It appears that data is not being transferred from the controller to the PC. The software displays these messages: "- Trying to connect to controller 1: controller1 192.168.10.60" and "- Successfully connected to controller 1: controller1 192.168.10.60". I programmed a button with VB address: 0 Bit: 0 and confirmed it accepts commands on the device. However, the status bar LED in [product_name] remains red. What might be the issue? Any help is appreciated!
Hi, please share your program so we can test it. Regards.
Hello, thank you for your reply.
The communication issue has been resolved! Everything is working perfectly now with the latest version of [product_name] Multi. Thanks to [user_name] from [product_name] support. Best regards.

analysis.insight_summary: Initially, the user experienced issues with data communication between the [product_name] Multi software and the hardware device, even though the network connection appeared successful. The lack of real-time input and output updates caused confusion. After troubleshooting, the user resolved the issue and reported full functionality with the current version, expressing satisfaction with the outcome.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated seamless, real-time data exchange between the [product_name] Multi software and the controller device, with accurate and immediate display of input and output statuses.
